messages.subject: Re: [tRophicPosition-support] Available in CRAN
messages.body_plain:
Hi Alejandra

We are working actually in solving some issues to have the package in CRAN soon. Andrew Jackson just transferred the package into my repository, now you can find it on http://github.com/clquezada/tRophicPosition

We are working on a release version (0.6.8), that will be ready soon (this week, or probably the next one).

I will let you know as soon as it is available.

Cheers,

Claudio

Claudio Quezada-Romegialli
Investigador Postdoctoral
Fish and Stable Isotope Ecology Lab
Universidad de Antofagasta
